newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fueL strengthens in slow market.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fueL strengthens in slow market.

text.p: NWE jet fuel firmed slightly in a relatively tight market but amid fairly relaxed buying and selling, traders said.
Jet fuel premiums for first half June delivery were quoted at June IPE gas oil +$19.50/+$20.50 fob ARA.
Traders said the German EBV tender for 250,000 tonnes of jet fuel over five months announced back in April was continuing to support the market although its effect were slowly petering out.
"It's a funny market. The EBV has diverted some buying interest to the barge market over the past five weeks," said one trader.
Cargoes were notionally priced at June IPE +$17.50 fob ARA. -- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714.
